newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen posts lower first half results.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen posts lower first half results.

text.p: Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien AG said on Thursday earnings in the first half of the year were below year-ago levels and expects the full year also not able to meet levels posted in 1995.
For the first half, Flughafen said pre-tax profit totalled 389 million schillings, down from 407 million, while net profit slipped to 263 million schillings from 278 million in the year-ago period.
Aviation turnover, which includes revenues from services such as handling and landing fees, rose 6.2 percent to 1.323 billion schillings.
Passenger traffic increased 8.1 percent to 4,256,348 passengers in the first half, while take-offs and landings increased 10.9 percent to 76,055 and freight gained 1.1 percent to 61,110 tonnes.
The company said the rise in maximum take-off weight of 13.7 percent was slightly above expectation. Long-haul flights were up 21.7 percent to 150,000 passenger departures.
